title: Recovered craft cannot be flown because consciousness pilots them
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Recovered craft cannot be flown because consciousness pilots them, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: they they they obviously ran into a major problem uh that they weren't able to Pilot the craft because it's Consciousness that Pilots the craft

plain: A lawyer named Dan Sheehan, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, passes along what he was told about craft not made by humans that the US government is said to have recovered. According to Sheehan, the people studying them hit a major problem: they could not fly the craft, because the craft are steered by the mind of the pilot, by consciousness itself.
